analysis.Alignment, Safety & Governance (A): Focuses on interpretability and transparency for stance predictions, which indirectly supports model trustworthiness, but does not explicitly address safety tuning, red-teaming, or governance measures.
analysis.Inference & Systems (S): Employs a zero-shot approach for inference on unseen targets, leveraging the interpretable design for transparent predictions, but no specifics on serving stacks, quantization, or distillation are provided.

analysis.Evaluation & Benchmarks (E): Conducts extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets (VAST, EZ-STANCE, P-Stance, RFD) with varying training data splits to evaluate generalizability and performance in zero-shot settings.
analysis.Architecture & Modeling (M): Proposes the IRIS framework that models stance detection as an information retrieval ranking task, incorporating implicit rationales (text sequences) and explicit rationales (linguistic features) without requiring ground-truth rationales.
